observations: Blue painted cast-metal gear reducer/gearbox unit shown from three angles.
Input-side flange with bolt holes visible on left in photo 0 and photo 1.
Yellow-painted output shaft protruding on the right side in photo 0, photo 1, and photo 2 (shaft end is keyed/hex-shaped).
Unit mounted on a cast baseplate with four bolt-down holes visible in photo 0 and photo 1.
Multiple bolted flange joints and ribbing consistent with a cast iron housing, visible in all three photos.
A lifting eye bolt is visible on top of the housing in photo 0 and photo 2.
Watermark text 'IFABROS INDUSTRAL POSTED ON JIJI' overlaid on all three photos; this is a marketplace watermark, not a nameplate on the item.
No manufacturer nameplate, serial tag, model number, ratio, or HP/kW rating plate is visible or legible in any photo.
No motor is attached; this is the reducer/gearbox alone.
Paint appears fresh/uniform with no visible rust, cracks, or oil leakage, but this could be a recent repaint rather than new condition.

identity.kind: industrial gear reducer / speed reducer gearbox (cast iron housing)

claims.evidence: No nameplate, rating tag, or stamped capacity is visible in photo 0, photo 1, or photo 2.
Housing shows cast ribbing, bolted flange construction, and casting texture typical of cast iron in photo 0, photo 1, and photo 2.

risks.risk: True horsepower/torque rating and gear ratio are unknown without a nameplate, which drives price heavily for this item class.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the manufacturer's nameplate or stamped rating on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a small/generic capacity cast gear reducer, not as a verified 15-20hp unit

risks.risk: Internal gear condition (wear, backlash, broken teeth) cannot be seen from outside.
risks.proof: Video of the output shaft being turned by hand or under power, showing smooth rotation without excessive play or noise.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed functional, i.e. as-is/for-parts risk

risks.risk: Unit could be used/reconditioned and repainted rather than new, masking wear or repairs.
risks.proof: Close-up of casting date code, serial stamp, or unpainted machined surfaces showing wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used condition, not as new

risks.risk: Oil seal and lubrication condition (leaks, dried seals) not visible under paint.
risks.proof: Photo of the shaft seal area and any drain/fill plug showing oil level or residue.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming seals may need replacement

risks.risk: Mounting dimensions and shaft diameter/keyway size, which must match the buyer's application, are not confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photo with a tape measure against the shaft diameter and bolt pattern.
risks.if_unproven: priced without fitment guarantee, treated as generic compatibility risk

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the nameplate/rating tag showing brand, model, ratio, and power rating.
Video of the shaft being rotated to show it turns freely without grinding or excessive backlash.
Photo of the oil fill/drain plug area and any visible oil residue or seal condition.
Measurement photo (tape measure) of output shaft diameter and base bolt spacing.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a cast-iron gear reducer/gearbox from the photos, so it can be priced at worst case as an unrated, condition-unverified unit; the seller's 15-20hp claim is unverifiable remote without a visible nameplate.
